findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: akari_reddit_sentiment, akari_batch, akari_deep, akari_endpoint_audit · Private data: akari_meme_radar, akari_wallet_intel, akari_batch, akari_deep, akari_launch_kit, akari_pass, akari_audit_plus, akari_akash_deploy_kit, akari_picks · Public sink: akari_batch, akari_deep, akari_launch_kit, akari_pass, akari_audit_plus · Destructive: akari_signal_execute, akari_akash_deploy_kit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: akari_reddit_sentiment, akari_batch, akari_deep, akari_endpoint_audit · Private data: akari_meme_radar, akari_wallet_intel, akari_batch, akari_deep, akari_launch_kit, akari_pass, akari_audit_plus, akari_akash_deploy_kit, akari_picks · Public sink: akari_batch, akari_deep, akari_launch_kit, akari_pass, akari_audit_plus · Destructive: akari_signal_execute, akari_akash_deploy_kit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
